record.question: Who was awarded the 2018 United Nations Human Rights Prize?
record.explanation: Answer A: Asma Jahangir. The United Nations named Asma Jahangir a posthumous recipient of its 2018 Human Rights Prize. Reference: https://press.un.org/en/2018/ga12109.doc.htm. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: February 2019 (cover page; no day given). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
